tournament.name: March 2024 OCC Clash Qualifier
tournament.description:
OCC CLASH MARCH SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - March 16 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline March 16 @ 1200 GMT)

  • The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season.

Round of 8 Finals - March 30 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline March 28 @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 6 qualified players being positioned in #3 to #8.
